senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (रयते)
To go, to move.

m. (-यः)
1 Speed, velocity.
2 The stream or current of a river.
E.
रय to go, घ aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Fleetest, very fleet.
m. (-ष्ठः)
1 KUVERA.
2 Fire or AGNI.
3 BRAHMĀ.
E.
रय speed used attributively, quick, and इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative.

n. (-णं)
1 Pain.
2 Sounding, crying, making a noise.
E.
रै to sound, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-टी)
The current or flow of a river.
